meta.workDescription: The 633d Logistics Readiness Squadron Ground Transportation element at Joint Base Langley-Eustis serves as the primary logistics hub for the 1st Fighter Wing’s F-22 Raptor mission and Headquarters Air Combat Command. Personnel manage a versatile fleet ranging from general-purpose passenger vehicles and distinguished visitor transport to heavy tractor-trailers, wreckers, and forklifts. A primary operational focus is Documented Cargo Operations (DCO), where Airmen conduct specialized airfield operations to facilitate the time-definite delivery of mission-critical supplies and aircraft components directly to flight line maintenance units. By synchronizing vehicle recovery, deployment distributions, and joint-service logistics with high-visibility personnel movement, this work center ensures the seamless flow of resources necessary for installation sustainment and global power projection
